title: sydney vlog 🇦🇺 | my first time in sydney & meeting fans in australia
description:
I had so much fun visiting Sydney for the first time! One of my favorite parts was all the little interactions I had with fans in town who love my music and CLC! I hope we’ll have the opportunity to perform in Australia someday. I can’t wait to go back next year.

Thank you to The Star Sydney for accommodating me during my stay at THE DARLING!
